recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current specification is correct after later Pharmacy decisions superseded the old status + wasNotTaken table; future MedicationStatement taking/not-taking work should continue to use adherence rather than restoring the old status interaction.
issue_request: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue asking whether to restrict which MedicationStatement.status values were allowed when the old wasNotGiven/wasNotTaken flag was true. The final WG direction said all statuses were possible and requested an explanatory status + wasNotTaken interpretation table rather than an invariant.
initial_application: Git commit 34be49d052 applied TR#8010 by adding the requested status + MedicationStatement.wasNotTaken interpretation table and a status clarification to the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet source. Later commit 3b901a8b98 for TR#12470 revised the old notTaken model to taken and added a status + taken guidance table.
additional_context: MedicationStatement remains active in source/fhir.ini, but wasNotTaken is now only present in a legacy [r2-renames] map. Current MedicationStatement.status is recorded | entered-in-error | draft and concerns the statement record; MedicationStatement.adherence carries taking/not-taking semantics. Later Published Pharmacy decisions FHIR-19468 and FHIR-39271 explicitly support that model, and FHIR-19468, FHIR-19470, and FHIR-39271 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the old table or adding an invariant would be obsolete because the current build has no MedicationStatement.wasNotTaken element to constrain and no longer uses status values such as active, completed, or intended to encode medication-use state.

related_jiras.note: Removed not-taken from MedicationUsage.status and directed taking/not-taking semantics to adherence, superseding the old status + wasNotTaken table model.
Paired later decision adding/renaming the adherence attribute that carries taking/not-taking information.
Reaffirmed that MedicationStatement.status reflects the statement record and MedicationStatement.adherence reflects whether medication is being taken.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification issue asking whether to restrict MedicationStatement statuses when wasNotGiven/wasNotTaken was true; final comments requested a status + wasNotTaken interpretation table instead.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the historical issue request and shows that the approved action was explanatory guidance, not a constraining invariant.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 34be49d052 applied TR#8010 by adding the status + MedicationStatement.wasNotTaken table and status clarification to the old spreadsheet source.
evidence_items.learned: The requested table was historically applied to the source model that existed when FHIR-8010 was resolved.

evidence_items.summary: TR#12470 later changed MedicationStatement.notTaken to taken and added a status + taken guidance table.
evidence_items.learned: The old status/notTaken guidance was part of a pre-R5 model that was revised before later being replaced by adherence.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationStatement is active in the current build; the remaining MedicationStatement.wasNotTaken entry is under the [r2-renames] legacy map.
evidence_items.learned: Current MedicationStatement inputs are in build scope, but wasNotTaken is not a current element requiring a status invariant or table.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationStatement.status is recorded | entered-in-error | draft and points taking/not-taking users to MedicationStatement.adherence, whose terminology includes not-taking.
evidence_items.learned: The current authoritative source already expresses the later status/adherence split that replaces the old status + wasNotTaken table.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-19468 resolved to remove not-taken from MedicationUsage.status and add adherence; FHIR-39271 later reaffirmed that MedicationStatement status is record status and adherence reflects taking/not-taking.
evidence_items.learned: Later final Pharmacy decisions supersede any current need to restore the old FHIR-8010 status + wasNotTaken guidance.

evidence_items.summary: A 2016 implementer thread quoted the FHIR-8010 status + wasNotTaken table while discussing MedicationStatement status semantics.
evidence_items.learned: This supports the historical context for FHIR-8010 and revealed no conflicting current work-group decision.
